header: The tier that gets a band of its own
subheader: Wider than a card, because the recommended plan is argued rather than listed.
bodytext: The rich text is where the argument goes: a paragraph or two on who this tier is for and what happens when they outgrow it. A card would only have room for one sentence.
note: The note carries the qualifications — tax, term, what a seat means.

features.title: Entitlements flow into two to four columns
One list, read down and then across
A row may carry a short qualifier
The price sits beside its period
Both actions live under the number
